debate.key_bull_argument: Multiple confluent technical signals (hull flip, three white soldiers, 15x volume spike, supertrend bullish, DC20 new high) with tech_score of 8 provide strong structural setup for continuation if macro stress eases.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro dislocation (VIX 179.4 crisis level, inverted yield curve, post-FOMC binary uncertainty) combined with overbought technicals (RSI 73, Stoch 81.45) and zero fundamental/sentiment conviction make this a high-risk fade into strength rather than a swing entry.
